title: Chapter 641
paragraphs: Chapter 641
Episode 164. The Land of the Demons(3)
Instead of answering, Padler swung his sword.
Storm-like thunder poured out from behind him along with his blade. It seemed as if a sea of lightning was spreading from nowhere around Padler.
Kaio quickly fired a barrage of divine slayer techniques to block the incoming thunder. The space filled with chaos was becoming brighter with the mixed blue forces.
“Looking at you again, it seems you're not a descendant but his ghost. Your name was Padler Run Candle, wasn't it?”
[I don't use that name anymore.]
Padler, who was breaking through the thunder penetrated by the divine slayer, was calmly distanced by Kaio, and Jin, who was at their center, drove into Padler's pursuit.
It was not Black Bradamante blocking Silus, but Sigmund. Suddenly, Jin's whole body, which had changed his sword, was covered with lightning.
Thunder based on aura and blue thunder based on magic power.
The lightning that the three emitted seemed to be of the exact same type despite having completely different roots.
“I'm not sure why you've become a ghost, but your resentment is too deep. Even though my memories of Temer are not completely intact, it seemed like he really cared about you.”
[I too have forgotten a lot. But I don't think I've heard of a noble clan prattling on. Do we need a long speech? Just confront each other with weapons.]
Swift and precise.
Those two words would be the summary of Padler's swordsmanship.
The only drawback to his swordsmanship, which had reached the realm of transcendence, was its sheer destructive power, which was even nullified by the added blue thunder.
Kaio fought from mid-range, and Jin engaged in close combat.

So both Jin and Padler fought with Kaio in mind. Padler was convinced that he needed to defeat Kaio to be able to attack Jin, while Jin believed that there would be a future as long as Kaio remained safe.
Because the fight with Padler was not the last.
'Kaio must finish before he gets tired.'
'I need to kill that Kaio quickly to handle Jin.'
There's no need for a pre-fight.
The three of them have been revealing their full strength from the beginning.
Whenever blades and arrows clashed with the lightning, the earth and the heavens seemed to turn over, screaming.
As if the sun were rising over the rotten sea, the three people's lightning was tearing through the chaos that filled the garden of swords.
If this sight, the fight between the oldest ancestor and the most recent descendant... were the brilliant light purifying the clan.
It would have been perfect.
But the inevitable reality was scratching at Jin's inside. The fact was making Jin more uncomfortable than the blue thunder that was tearing through his body.
As a character from a thousand years ago, Jin had never had any real interaction with Padler. All he had was a few records of him as an observer.
However, it felt like he was cutting a close friend, someone with whom he shared a deep bond just yesterday.
[Kaaaah!]
There was no such pain in Padler.
Before engaging swords, he had clearly stated that he had no personal feelings towards Jin, and it was undoubtedly true.
Yet, Jin saw him not as his distant descendant, but as Run Candle of that era, as a reincarnation of Temer.
You too should lose everything once.
That's what Padler's dark eyes seemed to be saying.
"Brother Jin!"
Blood spurted from Jin's throat. The Rune of Multa was now completely shattered and unable to function.
Even if it had been intact, it would have been meaningless. Against the old knight.
The wound was not deep. But a bit deeper, and it would have led straight to death.
Only then, seeing the blood droplets scattering in the air, did Jin realize that unnecessary emotions were taking root in his heart during the fight.
Sympathy, pity, guilt, or some complex emotion that's hard to explain. Padler wasn't an opponent who could be confronted with such feelings.
It required not just effort, but a determination to definitely kill him.
No one knew this better than Jin.
However, even though he had transcended humanity physically, he had not emotionally. Whether Padler's words were true or not, there was no doubt that he had given everything for the old Run Candle.
But, just as Padler had said that the hearts he once had couldn't replace everything he had lost.
The heart that once protected the clan couldn't advocate for him, now a ghost.
If it were person against person, it would have been understandable.
But now, Jin was standing against Padler as the next head of Run Candle.
It was unacceptable to have awkward feelings for someone trying to destroy the clan, no matter what the reason.
"There's one last thing I want to ask you, Sir Padler. Do you have no intention of stopping even now?"
[Refusal.]
"Then, as a current member of Run Candle, not as a descendant of Temer, I will execute you."
Jin closed his eyes once. The moment his eyelids closed, his feelings towards Padler also closed.
Before he opened his eyes again, Padler had opened the final move of the demonic sword he had achieved.
Blue Thunder Sword, Run Candle Demonic Sword Technique
Thunder Strike - Padler Run Candle.
The demonic sword technique that forms a pair with the flame of Yeomje Saja Run Candle.
Jin and Kaio could immediately recall the sword that forms the basis of that technique.
The completion of Flame and Thunder Strike was only after Temer passed down the mystery of the King Sword to the Ten Great Knights.
Kaio's gaze hardened.
"You too have spent your life chasing the shadow of Infinity."
Kaio too had devoted his life to reach that sword. To resemble the sword of devotion.
"However, it's a realm that can never be reached unless it is the original."
Facing Thunder Strike, Kaio first opened his King's Decisive Technique, 'Tidal Wave'.
The thunderstorm started by Padler and Kaio took on the same form, enough to be called the same technique.
The process of those seeking the summit tends to yield similar results.
"Do you want to say that you are the original, Ming Wang clan?"
"No. Even though you're an enemy, I just want to pay my respects. To the fact that someone who never belonged to the Ming Wang is struggling in the same position as me."
If there's one difference between Kaio and Padler, it was their 'body'.
The Thunder Strike, the power symbolizing the Ming Wang clan, required a body that could handle it. Just as a blessed body is needed to use Run Candle's decisive technique.
"But can you withstand it? With that helpless human body."
That was exactly why Padler's old comrades called him fragile. His sword was covering his congenital deficiency by staking his life.
"After all, it's a body that's already died once, you keep talking nonsense."
Kaio smirked.
Unlike Jin, he didn't harbor any special emotions towards Padler.
He was just happy that a strong opponent was standing there, as he came to fight for his brother.
Tidal Wave and Thunder Strike were overlapping. Still, Jin was just restricting Padler from closing the distance with Kaio.
He was enduring until Padler's energy was maximally exhausted to gather strength.
From then on, Padler began to put pressure mainly on Jin instead of Kaio, and it looked like Kaio was protecting Jin with all his strength.
As a result, Kaio was getting wounded. If the combined offensive as before had continued, Padler would have been the one starting to get seriously injured.
"It's inefficient."
It certainly seemed so on the surface.
Padler could not help but guess.
There must be a reason for this inefficient shift in offense.
It's probably that energy shining from Jin's heart right now.
Of course, even that was a considerable amount of energy.
But so far, that's all it was.
As Kaio hinted, Jin did not think that this power could sublimate into the 'original'.
Because Jin was not Genesis.
He didn't think Jin could show that realm, the land at the summit that not even he himself had finally set foot on, which was considered to have only been reached by Temer a thousand years ago.
However, as the Tidal Wave and Thunder Strike reached their peak, Kaio was speaking with a confident voice.
"Now show it, Jin. To our ancestral spirits."
The true sword of the summit.
Kaio added the final words, and the energy concentrated in Jin's heart began to explode in all directions.
King Sword Devotion Technique 10th Sword
Kingdom Domination Sword - Open
Suddenly, Tidal Wave and Thunder Strike stopped moving. Like predators halting when a bigger beast appears.
Jin didn't stop there and opened the next chapter, the 2nd form of the 10th sword of Kingdom Domination Sword, Total War.
A heavy will to annihilate those standing against the King was instilled in Sigmund.
Kaio took a proud breath, and Padler stared at Jin with a stiff body for a moment.
He saw Temer himself from Jin, and soon realized that it was just an illusion.
The man standing before him was neither Temer nor an old member of Run Candle.
It was Jin Run Candle. A current and extraordinary Run Candle, living now, not a thousand years ago, like himself.
'However... nothing changes.'
Padler was neither moved nor scared by this sight.
Nothing changes, his grudge to annihilate him and watch the destruction of Run Candle did not waver.
The black clouds gathering with Jin's will obscured Ram, who was under pressure.
Those in the giant forces attacking Rosa, the Prophet, and Huphester could all watch this sight.
'Even if my body and soul eventually do not remain in either the surface or hell, or any abyss of chaos. Even if my name and what I've lost are erased from the world again.'
The light of Thunder Strike, which began to sway again, radiated an even brighter light.
The resumed Thunder Strike was surpassing all the swords Padler had unfolded in his lifetime.
'I will hinder you from saving Run Candle.'
Suddenly, a faint memory came to Padler's mind.
A long time ago, he seemed to have had a similar conversation to the words he had just uttered.
'- Even if my body and mind, and the ones I love, eventually disappear completely from this world. Even if despair and nightmares are all that is left in the end. I will protect Run Candle with you.'
For some reason, Padler's words from that time were also spreading in Jin's inner self like a distant echo.
But Jin did not stop his sword.
Tears welled up in Jin's eyes drenched in thunder, and Padler's eyes, stepping forward, contained endless emptiness.
